ruling: Exact user-visible copy is settled by the working seats' shared design pass for EV-16 and EV-17, constrained by each card's Acceptance substrings; no run-level string is fixed. A seat applying this ruling must keep every string the card's Acceptance requires and settle wording only within the design pass the cards already name.

The server-URL default constant is `DEFAULT_SERVER_URL` and the single shared resolver is `resolveServerUrl`, resolving env → setting → stored credential → default. The three runtime resolve sites consult that resolver; the default is the last-resort tier below any stored credential.

Uncertainty display is settled by the working seats within each card's Acceptance; no run-level uncertainty-display rule is fixed, because EPIC-7 surfaces no no-realtime-availability data and no price data.

EV-16's `login.failure.browserOpenFailed` English row reads exactly: `Could not open a browser — on a remote machine run /rc:login --headless. No credentials were saved.` EV-15's `rc.serverUrlRequired` / `login.failure.noServerUrl` become unreachable and are removed, with the removal named in the PR description.

The routing gate's verdict is kept as information only: the recorded execution mode is read mechanically by the deterministic merge check and reported in the Phase 3 run ledger. It is never surfaced as a blocking human prompt during this run.
